app_summary: An online shop selling astronomy products, based on the OpenTelemetry Demo. It is built with polyglot microservices (Go, Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Rust, ...) communicating via gRPC and HTTP behind an Envoy frontend-proxy, with Kafka for asynchronous order processing and Valkey as cart store. Supported Operations: View product catalog, Receive product recommendations and ads, Add item to cart, Checkout with selected items, Currency conversion, Process payment, Generate shipping quotes, Send order confirmation emails

rca_analyses_list.diagnosis: OpenSearch node opensearch-0 exhausted available memory (container_memory_usage_bytes ~1.0067GB, working_set ~954MB out of limit ~1.153GB) and became slow/pressured; it logged slow cluster-state writes and refused data due to high memory usage. Jaeger (jaeger-55bb78686d-q7g4q) reported "failed to upload metrics: ... data refused due to high memory usage", causing Jaeger to be unable to persist/serve traces. As a result traces for the entry-point frontend-proxy are not available.

args.root_cause: OpenSearch node opensearch-0 exhausted available memory (container_memory_usage_bytes ~1.0067GB, working_set ~954MB out of limit ~1.153GB) and became slow/pressured; it logged slow cluster-state writes and refused data due to high memory usage. Jaeger (jaeger-55bb78686d-q7g4q) reported "failed to upload metrics: ... data refused due to high memory usage", causing Jaeger to be unable to persist/serve traces. As a result traces for the entry-point frontend-proxy are not available.
args.evidence_summary: 1) get_traces for frontend-proxy returned no traces. 2) frontend-proxy logs show normal Envoy startup (no downstream 5xx). 3) Jaeger pod logs contain: "failed to upload metrics: reader collect and export timeout: ... data refused due to high memory usage". 4) OpenSearch pod logs show warnings: "writing cluster state took [25617ms] ..." and "writing cluster state took [13409ms]", indicating slowness. 5) Pod metrics for opensearch-0: container_memory_usage_bytes=1006678016, container_memory_working_set_bytes=954388480, container_spec_memory_limit_bytes=1153433600 — memory usage is near the limit. 6) Jaeger pod metrics show high memory RSS/working set (~179.7MB RSS, limit 629,145,600) and Jaeger reported being unable to upload metrics. These together indicate OpenSearch memory pressure caused write refusals and Jaeger trace ingestion/storage failure.
args.investigation_summary: I listed pods/services, confirmed frontend-proxy has no error traces, inspected frontend-proxy logs (no 5xx), checked Jaeger logs which reported upload failures due to "high memory usage", checked OpenSearch logs which showed slow cluster-state writes, and retrieved Prometheus metrics showing OpenSearch memory usage is near its container limit. The chain of evidence points to OpenSearch memory pressure refusing writes and causing Jaeger to fail to store traces; tracing is degraded though application services themselves remain running.
